digest.component_or_area: CLI / bridge noun group and subcommand dispatch
propositions: bridge preview and bridge sync verbs must be functional with preview performing no Jira or ticket-store writes and sync performing mutations
Legacy commands (reconcile, jira-onboard, bridge-probe, bridge-fsck) and existing in-repo consumers must remain fully functional after bridge noun surface ships
Nested bridge subcommand dispatch must not fall through to top-level commands, and unimplemented sibling verbs must not be advertised before their functional implementations land
Mode, MODE_CAPS, and gated_mode reconcile-check round trip must survive intact in src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/mode.py
User guide, CLI reference, and release notes must document only the staged surface verbs that actually ship (preview and sync)
Existing rebar doctor top-level command for store link repair must remain functional and bridge doctor must remain unknown
